drops.candidate: Passaic County Domestic and Sexual Violence Center, formerly Passaic County Women's Center
drops.reason: Its own page says the site is no longer active and information has moved to the NJAC website. The NJAC home page opened in this run did not state this center's Paterson shelter or domestic violence services.
Its own services page places its main office and houses in Wanaque. No Paterson location or Paterson service is stated on that page.
Its own page presents admission based substance use treatment and residential programs. It was not counted as a general shelter, food, or walk in clinic listing for this board.
Its home page mentions housing for vulnerable populations in general terms only. No housing address, hours, or access details are stated on that page. Its fresh produce offer is listed instead.
Its own page states clothing is sold at reduced prices. No free clothing offer is stated on that page, so it was not listed as a free hygiene or clothing offer.
No provider page opened in this run stated a free public charging offer in Paterson. The charging category was left empty rather than filled from a listing site.

expiry_rule: Every listing expires 30 days after the date it was verified. A listing past its expiry is shown as stale, never silently.

listings.offer: Meals at Eva's Community Kitchen. Breakfast on weekdays and lunch are served.

listings.offer: Groceries from the Choice Marketplace, by appointment only. Each guest may receive up to one appointment per month. You must live in Passaic County to register for CUMAC support.
listings.when: All appointments can be scheduled between the hours of 9:30 am and 2:30 pm (Monday through Friday). Every Wednesday there are additional late night shopping appointments between 4:00 pm and 6:00 pm.
listings.where: The provider page does not state a street address.
